title: Create observe-only Staff OS control views
businessObjective: Advance Phase 1 — Trusted control foundation through one bounded staff-os outcome.
technicalObjective: Create the finite Staff OS Control Views V1 schema, static view-set artifact, and deterministic offline validator exactly as defined in docs/staff-os/P1-008_OBSERVE_ONLY_CONTROL_VIEWS_V1_DESIGN.md.
architectureReferences: docs/architecture/source/Sri U-Thong Grand Hotel AI OS.md
assumptions: P1-008 is a static repository contract in Tier 0 observe-only mode; it must not create a live Staff OS UI, API, service, data query, data store, queue, workflow, mutable state, or production integration.

The only V1 source authorities are the completed P1-002 control-plane contract, P1-003 append-only audit contract, and P1-007 deny-only kill-switch decision boundary; P1-008 may reference their finite metadata but may not redefine or treat them as live data sources.

No production write, deployment, database, network, external service, credential, guest-data, booking, payment, inventory, pricing, authorization, approval, execution, or audit-store access is authorized.
A separate governance packet must admit the exact future validator command after the validator exists and before P1-008 independent machine verification.
acceptanceCriteria: schemas/staff-os-control-views-v1.schema.json is the closed Draft 2020-12 structural authority for the documented finite V1 view set and accepts no extra properties.

apps/staff-os/staff-os-control-views-v1.json contains exactly the documented identity, Tier 0 observe-only mode, production-write prohibition, and three static contract-reference views: workflow-control-plane, append-only-audit-record, and deny-only-kill-switch-decision.

Each V1 view is contract metadata only: it has an exact canonical source reference, fixed display fields, the sole permitted action observe, and a no-live-data state; it contains no endpoint, query, credential, command, executable callback, action control, authorization, approval, or mutable configuration.

The workflow view references only the P1-002 workflow_runs fields id, correlationId, status, and triggerEventId; the audit view references only the P1-003 record fields id, correlationId, recordedAt, actorType, actionType, and outcome; and the kill-switch view references only the P1-007 public observe request and closed deny decision fields schemaVersion, decision, reasonCode, and controlId.

node tests/staff-os/validate-observe-only-control-views-v1.mjs loads the committed canonical schema and artifact from repository-relative paths, verifies the finite V1 contract and static P1-007 observe decision, and rejects focused mutations without caller-supplied replacement authority, live access, writes, or network activity.

Malformed JSON, altered source references, unexpected fields or views, any non-observe action, live-data claim, action endpoint, query, command, enabled write, approval, authorization, execution, or changed finite field list fail deterministically with a nonzero exit.

P1-008 adds no UI runtime, API, server, database, data fetch, audit writer, policy evaluator, approval workflow, executor, notification, queue, scheduler, deployment, credential, network, guest-data, booking, payment, inventory, pricing, or production behavior.
The exact validator runs explicitly in CI, and independent QA confirms forbidden paths were untouched after a separate exact-command verifier admission is merged.
allowedCommands: npm run verify:task -- --task SUT-AIOS-P1-008 --verifier-agent qa-verification --verifier-model gpt-5.6-sol --acceptance-confirmed
requiredChecks: finite Staff OS Control Views V1 contract validation
machine verification evidence after exact-command admission
solEscalationTriggers: Any proposal broadens the finite view set, adds a live UI, API, service, data access, action control, mutable configuration, authorization, approval, execution, external access, credential, production write, payment, booking, RLS, migration, concurrency, or workflow behavior.
Any required change crosses the exact artifact, schema, validator, design, CI, task-state, or evidence paths.
Any ambiguity about source authority, exact static P1-007 observe decision, or verifier admission.
rollbackExpectations: Revert only the P1-008 static view artifact, schema, validator, design document, explicit CI step, task-state changes, and P1-008 evidence; preserve P1-002/P1-003/P1-007 authorities and evidence, completed records, canonical architecture sources, the immutable compatibility snapshot, and all external systems.
